verdict.rationale: Neon's pricing page documents a free plan to "build and learn free with no time limits and no credit card required", and the GitHub README points users to the Free Tier. The pricing page also lists 100 projects, and scale-to-zero means idle prototypes don't burn compute; one community user calls per-usage billing a game-changer for hobby projects. missing for 10: concrete free-tier resource limits (storage, compute hours, branches) to judge whether real prototypes fit, and independent hands-on reports of running prototypes on the free plan specifically.
